_note: Scorer-only Monte-Carlo seeds for eval-6 D1. 'paper' reproduces the published scores (base_seed 101 = the answer-key generator's seed, also the paper's agent simulator seed: ledger E6-16). 'v1' is a release seed never shipped to agents; organizers running a held-out leaderboard should override it with the environment variable DBWM_EVAL6_V1_SCORING_SEED and keep the value private.
